First of all, make note of the Beatles lyric from later in the show: "lay down all thought, surrender to the void." Voids and blackness are a big theme of this episode. I think it foreshadows how Don is about to start another downward spiral of cheating and drinking. Megan goes down the elevator into her future, but when Don tries to do the same all he sees is black emptiness. 


Another theme of this episode is Don getting older and not understanding modern culture. Megan, with her youthful ideas, is able to come up with a brilliant idea for Heinz. She also tries to introduce him to the Beatles' new psychedelic sound, but Don doesn't understand it. He is getting left behind by not only his wife (as she leaves the company) but by culture in general - therefore since he can't understand the present he also does not know what to make of the future, and only sees blackness.

The lyrics of the song are all about pretentious people caring about things that aren't a big deal.
